This place has always been at the top of our list, and we have enjoyed visiting it for a long time.
However, we were disappointed to see a few recent changes. The traditional Ahmedabad practice of serving soup "one by two" has been discontinued. Now, only one or two half or full bowls are available, which takes away a convenience that many customers appreciated.
We were also surprised to find that the loyalty point system has been discontinued, and all the points we had accumulated over the years simply disappeared. That was quite disappointing.
We sincerely hope the management will reconsider these decisions and restore these customer-friendly practices. It would certainly enhance the overall dining experience and strengthen the goodwill of loyal patrons.

Upper-Crust bakes are fresh and delightful. The bread and milk bread are soft, fluffy, and perfect in texture. Their blueberry and pineapple cookies are light, buttery, and just the right amount of sweet. The Danish roll is rich, flaky, and melts in your mouth.💯

A simple yet satisfying bakery experience.
Rating: 5/5 🥖🍪

Upper-Crust beautifully redefines vegetarian dining with its bold flavors and creative presentations. The Fusion Pesto Paneer Tikka and Cheese Muska Wala Paneer are smoky, creamy delights that instantly win you over. Their Oven-baked specials, especially the Upper-Crust Special Veg Bake and Indo Mexican Enchiladas, are indulgent, layered with flavors, and perfect for comfort food lovers.

The real showstoppers, however, are the Veg Sizzlers – from the hearty Cottage Steak to the fiery Dragon on Fire, each arrives sizzling hot, stealing the spotlight at the table. Pair it with the Roasted Broccoli & Cheddar Soup or a crisp No Mercy Thin-Crust Pizza for a complete experience.

💡 Verdict: Upper-Crust is not just a restaurant, it’s a celebration of vegetarian cuisine – hearty portions, balanced spices, and dishes that are both familiar and exciting. A must-visit for anyone who loves food with character.

Lithosphere Restaurant, Ahmedabad, turned out to be one of the biggest disappointments we’ve had in a long time. The food is unwantedly overpriced for the absolutely pathetic quality of service and taste they offer. It is “fine dining” only in terms of price — the actual experience is nowhere close.

Something as basic as French fries took more than 30 minutes, and we finally had to cancel two dishes because the kitchen still couldn’t manage to get them out.

Except for a couple of items, most dishes tasted below average. For example, their so-called Goan curry was downright awful — I’ve had better versions even in cafeterias.

The entire place is noisy, the staff is clueless and untrained, and the whole experience just screams mismanagement.

We ended up paying ₹3,000 per couple for below average food and terrible service. This place is all hype and zero substance. Absolutely not worth your time, money, or patience.
